senses.definition_en: retinue; posse

examples.english: […] Leonel Fernández, former Dominican president, asked the OAS for “some caution” when invoking for Venezuela the Inter-American Democratic Charter. […] Caution in the face of the repressive wave against a starving people, carried out by retinues or armed colectivos and the praetorian Bolivarian National Guard, leaving dead or wounded people along the way and hundreds more imprisoned in the east and the rest of the country?
examples.ref: 2016 July 5, “Leonel y las negociaciones secretas [Leonel and the secret negotiations]”, in El Nacional, archived from the original on 06 Jul 2016:
examples.text: […]Leonel Fernández, ex presidente dominicano, pide de la OEA “cierta cautela” al invocar para Venezuela la Carta Democrática Interamericana. […] ¿Cautela ante la ola represora de un pueblo hambriento, que ejecutan mesnadas o colectivos armados y la pretoriana Guardia Nacional Bolivariana, dejando muertos y heridos a la vera y otros centenares de presos en oriente y el resto del país?
examples.translation: […] Leonel Fernández, former Dominican president, asked the OAS for “some caution” when invoking for Venezuela the Inter-American Democratic Charter. […] Caution in the face of the repressive wave against a starving people, carried out by retinues or armed colectivos and the praetorian Bolivarian National Guard, leaving dead or wounded people along the way and hundreds more imprisoned in the east and the rest of the country?

glosses: retinue; posse
